description:
Jonghyun, who works at a hotel to pay off his brother’s debt, scrapes by with just enough money to pay the private loan sharks, who also pay him visits at the hotel. He can barely stand it. Soon, Youngjin, a red-haired bully, tells him that he would help pay off his debts if he goes out with him...?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/e_stairs), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hotel_christmas), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434011491)

**Official Translations:**  
[Thai](https://www.boomtoon.com/detail/emergency_exit), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/e_stairs)

***Note:**  
Part of Penis Navida: [Hotel XMAS](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=3350491531) 2020 event by Bomtoon, this is Story 4 (Ch.11-13) on Lezhin*
